title: Movement_Modes
evidence: Chosen during Character Creation, a character's Movement Mode affects the character's speed, movement style, and maneuvers in combat. It also determines if the character is a flyer, speedster or jumps from building to building as an acrobat.

title: Movement_Styles
evidence: Movement Styles Movement Styles are visually enhanced movement effects for all movement modes. Each style applies to all four movement modes and can be claimed by all characters on the account. Movement Styles are available from the marketplace and other sources such as Time Capsules. They were introduced with Hotfix 29/08/18.

title: Renown
evidence: Hero Factions Renown Renown is one of the leveling systems in the DC Universe Online. Renown points are earned by completing specific missions in the game. Reaching a renown threshold with factions grants access to exclusive gear and feat points. - Neutral: 1 - 999 points - Cooperative: 1,000 - 2,499 points - Friendly: 2,500 - 4,499 points - Favorable: 4,500 - 6,499 points - Trusted: 6,500 points

title: Stats
evidence: Stats Below is a listing of all the statistics for a character. Statistics determine how a character will fare in a battle against another character and are increased by gaining levels or spending skill points on specific abilities that can temporarily enhance character stats. Retroactively, specific abilities can also be used to temporarily decrease character stats.

title: Tank_Role
evidence: The Tank or Defensive role is one of the four roles available in DC Universe Online. This role generally focuses on keeping the group safe by attracting opponents, taking damage in place of other group members and providing control immunity to the group. Tank armor tends to have high Health and Dominance as well as high Defense or Toughness. The symbol that represents a tank is a Shield.

title: Traits
evidence: Traits are the Powers and Weapon sets that the player character possesses, the Movement Mode used to get around and enhance their abilities, the Stat Points used to level up abilities and stats, and the Loadouts used to organize and summon these traits. The Traits Menu gives you access to fine tune your character with the following: - Powers Gadgets - Loadouts - Weapons - Movement Modes Acrobatics
